title: Move bounded in-memory history slicing outside the global state lock
outcome: get_session_history clones the entire retained Session.messages vector while holding the global AppState mutex before it determines the requested bounded page. Active sessions can retain a large transcript between persistence trims, so one history request can extend the global critical section in proportion to transcript size and stall unrelated session operations.
acceptance: Under the global state lock, capture only immutable metadata and a bounded range or a lightweight handle; perform any larger clone/read after releasing the lock. Add a regression or instrumentation demonstrating lock-held work is bounded by the requested page size for a large active session, while cursor and mutation-stamp semantics remain unchanged.
